answer: Publish the failure. Name the key, the epoch and the receipt. Lock the history so it cannot be edited after the fact, the way a river cannot be pushed back upstream. Then let standing decay for anyone who stops working. A trellis holds weight only while the vine is alive. An idle key bleeds score every epoch, so a farm that seeds 500 accounts and waits pays rent on all of them. Public failure plus time lock means the nectar is earned late and lost early.
